docs.title: 3DLA MoM｜5 steps
docs.text:
📊 Finish Overview → 📝 Generate MoM 1 💾 Finish and save tomorrow's Overview 2 ❌ Close every Word window 3 🖱️ Double-click the .cmd file in MoM Close Word First - Generate Tomorrow 3DLA MoM.cmd 4 📄 Open the new Word file 5 🔎 Check 4 places

Date · Meeting no. · Attachment A · Attachment B

A MoM for the same date already exists

The tool stops without overwriting. Use -Overwrite only when you are sure.

Folder locations
  • MoM: OAIC Ltd\PROJECT_TWSHXESR - Documents\General\3-Day Look Ahead - 3DLA\MoM
  • Overview: OAIC Ltd\PROJECT_TWSHXESR - Documents\General\3-Day Look Ahead - 3DLA\Overview
Regenerate the same date 
powershell -Sta -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "Generate Tomorrow 3DLA MoM - Code.ps1" -TargetDate "2026-07-06" -Overwrite -Open

docs.title: 3DLA MoM｜5 步完成
docs.text:
📊 Overview 完成後 → 📝 產生 MoM 1 💾 完成並儲存明日 Overview 2 ❌ 關閉所有 Word 視窗 3 🖱️ 在 MoM 資料夾雙擊 .cmd Close Word First - Generate Tomorrow 3DLA MoM.cmd 4 📄 開啟新產生的 Word 5 🔎 檢查 4 個位置

Date · Meeting no. · Attachment A · Attachment B

同一天的 MoM 已存在

程式會停止，不會覆蓋。確定要重做時，才使用 -Overwrite。

資料夾位置
  • MoM：OAIC Ltd\PROJECT_TWSHXESR - Documents\General\3-Day Look Ahead - 3DLA\MoM
  • Overview：OAIC Ltd\PROJECT_TWSHXESR - Documents\General\3-Day Look Ahead - 3DLA\Overview
重新產生同一天的 MoM 
powershell -Sta -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "Generate Tomorrow 3DLA MoM - Code.ps1" -TargetDate "2026-07-06" -Overwrite -Open

docs.title: 3DLA Overview｜4 steps
docs.text:
1 ❌ Close the latest Overview Excel 2 🖱️ Double-click the .cmd file Close Excel First - Generate Tomorrow 3DLA.cmd 3 ⏳ Wait until it finishes

The new file appears in the same folder.

4 🔎 Open → Check → Issue

Date · Activities · Simops · Remarks

Error?

Close every Excel window, then run the .cmd file again.

What the tool does automatically
  • Creates tomorrow's file and updates the date
  • Moves look-ahead activities forward
  • Adjusts rows and colours
  • Keeps Simops / Remarks

docs.title: 3DLA Overview｜4 步完成
docs.text:
1 ❌ 關閉最新的 Overview Excel 2 🖱️ 雙擊 .cmd Close Excel First - Generate Tomorrow 3DLA.cmd 3 ⏳ 等待程式完成

新檔案會自動出現在同一個資料夾。

4 🔎 打開新檔 → 檢查 → 發出

Date · Activities · Simops · Remarks

出現錯誤？

關閉所有 Excel 視窗，再雙擊 .cmd。

程式自動完成的內容
  • 產生明日檔案並更新日期
  • 將 look-ahead activities 往前帶
  • 自動調整列數與底色
  • 保留 Simops / Remarks

docs.title: DPR｜5 steps
docs.text:
1 ❌ Close every Word window 2 🖱️ Double-click the .cmd file in DPR Close Word First - Generate Tomorrow DPR.cmd 3 ⏱️ Wait about 1 minute

The CMD window may stay open while it works.

4 🔓 Open the new DPR → Enable Content

5 💾 Fill in → Fit Pictures → Ctrl + S

Date · Activities · Photos · Teams offshore

DPR is a .docm file

Word AutoSave is not supported. Press Ctrl + S before closing.

What the tool does automatically
  • Updates file name, Doc No., Report Date and footer
  • Imports past / next 24hrs activities from 3DLA Overview
  • Clears old photos and resets #1–#8
  • Keeps 8 OSS / TJB picture slots
  • Updates Toolbox Meeting / PTW totals

docs.title: DPR｜5 步完成
docs.text:
1 ❌ 關閉所有 Word 視窗 2 🖱️ 在 DPR 資料夾雙擊 .cmd Close Word First - Generate Tomorrow DPR.cmd 3 ⏱️ 等待約 1 分鐘

CMD 視窗停留是正常的。

4 🔓 開啟新 DPR → Enable Content

5 💾 填寫 → Fit Pictures → Ctrl + S

Date · Activities · Photos · Teams offshore

DPR 是 .docm

Word AutoSave 不支援。關閉前按 Ctrl + S。

程式自動完成的內容
  • 更新檔名、Doc No.、Report Date、頁尾
  • 從 3DLA Overview 帶入 past / next 24hrs activities
  • 清除舊照片並重設 #1–#8
  • 保留 8 格 OSS / TJB Pictures
  • 更新 Toolbox Meeting / PTW totals

docs.title: ESR P/CP Training｜Follow the numbers
docs.text:
About 95% automated · Small bugs are fixed as found ▶️ Always double-click this file first Run ESR Training Automation (English).cmd 1　OpenDouble-click the .cmd file above. 2　Type a numberClick the black window and type, for example, 5-1. 3　Press EnterThe menu is not clickable. Press the keyboard Enter key.

🔍 Click any instruction image to enlarge it. Use ＋／－ to zoom and Esc to close.

Remember: Steps 3, 7, 8 and 10 can send real emails

Check the name and email address before running them. The other Steps do not send emails.

docs.title: Open once each day: follow only this line
docs.text:
1. Type 5-1 → press Enter → six online result workbooks open.
  2. If asked, choose your OAIC / @oaic.io account. Keep the pages open for 1–2 minutes.
  3. Return to the black window. Run 5-2 only if white pending rows exist. If there are no white rows, today's check is finished.

docs.title: Click a Step to jump to its instructions
docs.text:
Step 1Import contractor listWrites to Register Step 2Add Site accessChanges SharePoint access Step 3Send invitationSends immediately Step 4Show white rowsView only Step 5-1Open result workbooksOnce each day Step 5-2Check latest resultsRun after 5-1 Step 6Create PDF certificatesCreates files Step 7Send certificatesSends immediately Step 8Send re-training emailSends immediately Step 9Repair Register syncOnly after a failure Step 10Check old certificateSends if valid First use: install tools + show Outlook Bcc
  1. Double-click Install ESR Automation Prerequisites.cmd.
  2. Wait for Python packages OK.
  3. Outlook: File → Settings.
  1. Mail → Compose → Always show Bcc.
Where are the folders?
  • Main tool folder: OAIC Ltd\PROJECT_TWSHXESR - Documents\General\ESR AutoDoc Hub\04_ESR Training
  • Contractor lists: 01_Inbox\P_CP Candidate Lists
  • Email templates: 00_Template\Training email Templates
  • Training results: 02_Processing
  • Certificates: 04_Certificates
  • Formal Register: Safety Document - SFD Register\TWSHXHV_ESR_OverallRegister.xlsm
  • Worksheet written by the tool: Old Training Register

Stuck?

Close related Excel files and Outlook drafts, then run the same Step again from the English .cmd. If the screen shows FAILED, ERROR or WARNING, take a screenshot before continuing.

docs.title: Step 1｜Import a contractor P/CP candidate list
docs.text:
WHENYou receive the completed contractor Excel list.

DOPlace the file → type 1 → press Enter.

RESULTPeople are written to the formal Register; the source Excel moves to Archive.

  1. No list yet: open 00_Template\Training email Templates and send 1. Person _ CP Candidate Request.oft.
  2. When the Excel file returns, place it in 01_Inbox\P_CP Candidate Lists.
  3. Open the English .cmd, type 1, then press Enter.
  4. Done. Imported... means the import is complete.
  5. If CONTRACTOR REPLY - Candidate Validity Confirmation appears, open Template 2, paste the text copied by the tool, and send it to the contractor.

docs.title: Step 2｜Add SharePoint Site access
docs.text:
WHENStep 1 added new white pending rows.

DOType 2, press Enter, then choose Chrome, Edge, or Firefox.

RESULTThe candidate receives ESR Training Hub Site access.

  1. Type 2, then press Enter.
  2. At the browser question, press Enter for Chrome, type E for Edge, or type F for Firefox.
  3. Do not use the mouse or keyboard while it is running.
  4. 完成 SharePoint Site access：成功 ... means “Site access completed” and confirms it is finished.

No white pending rows

There is nothing to process. Return to the menu.

docs.title: Step 3｜Send a Training invitation
docs.text:
WHENThe person has completed Step 2.

DOType 3, then enter one trainee email.

RESULTOutlook immediately sends that person's Training invitation.

  1. Confirm which person should receive the invitation.
  2. Type 3, then press Enter.
  3. Enter the requested single email address, then press Enter.
  4. Only SENT: ... training invitation confirms that it was sent.

This Step sends an email

If the email is wrong, do not press Enter. Close the black window and start again.

docs.title: Step 4｜Show white pending rows
docs.text:
WHENYou want to see who is still waiting.

DOType 4, then press Enter.

RESULTThe black window lists names, levels and emails. Nothing is changed.

目前沒有偵測到白底待處理人員 means “No white pending rows detected”. Nobody needs Steps 5-2, 6 or 7 at this time.

docs.title: Step 5-1｜Open online result workbooks first
docs.text:
WHENOnce when you open the tool each day.

DOType 5-1 → choose a browser → wait 1–2 minutes.

RESULTSix Microsoft Forms response workbooks open and update the local results.

  1. Type 5-1, then press Enter.
  2. Press Enter for Chrome. Type E only for Edge.
  3. Six result pages open. If Microsoft asks for an account, choose your OAIC / @oaic.io account.
  4. Keep the pages open and wait 1–2 minutes.
  5. Return to the same black window and continue with Step 5-2.

docs.title: Step 5-2｜Check the latest Training Hub results
docs.text:
WHENStep 5-1 has synced and white pending rows still exist.

DOType 5-2, then press Enter.

RESULTEach candidate shows PASSED or WAIT.

  • Person: total score ≥ 36 is PASSED.
  • CP: Module 1 ≥ 20 and Module 2 ≥ 20 are both required.
  • WAIT: do not continue to Steps 6 or 7.
  • PASSED: continue to Step 6.

docs.title: Step 6｜Create PDF certificates
docs.text:
WHENStep 5-2 shows PASSED.

DOType 6, then press Enter.

RESULTPerson / CP PDF certificates are created in 04_Certificates.

  1. Type 6, then press Enter.
  2. 完成，已自動產生以上 PDF 證書 means the PDF certificates were generated.
  3. Open 04_Certificates and check the name, level and PDF.

docs.title: Step 7｜Send Certificate emails
docs.text:
WHENYou have checked every PDF created by Step 6.

DOType 7, then press Enter.

RESULTAll ready certificates are sent and the Register sync is attempted.

  1. Close unrelated Outlook drafts.
  2. Type 7, then press Enter.
  3. If an “unconfirmed” retry list appears, enter a number/email only for a retry. Press Enter for the normal pending list.
  4. Each person needs SENT: email, followed by Register synchronization completed.

This sends every certificate that is ready

Check all PDFs in 04_Certificates first. Do not use Step 7 as a test.

docs.title: Step 8｜Send Re-training Required emails
docs.text:
WHENStep 5-2 confirmed that a person failed and must retake training.

DOType 8, then press Enter.

RESULTAll confirmed failed trainees not yet notified receive a re-training email.

  1. Use Step 5-2 first and confirm who failed.
  2. Only after the list is correct, type 8, then press Enter.
  3. The tool lists the recipients and continues with sending. Only SENT: re-training required email confirms success.

This Step sends emails

If you are unsure who will receive them, do not run it.

docs.title: Step 9｜Repair the Training Register sync
docs.text:
WHENOnly when Step 7 sent the email but reported a Register sync failure.

DOClose the Register workbook → type 9 → press Enter.

RESULTSent status, certificate number and dates are written back to the Register.

Normally, do not run Step 9. If Step 7 shows Register synchronization completed, you are finished.

docs.title: Step 10｜Check an old valid certificate and send notice
docs.text:
WHENA trainee says they passed before, but Step 5-2 finds no result.

DOType 10, then enter the full email address.

RESULTIf a certificate is still valid, an English validity notice is sent immediately.

  1. Type 10, then press Enter.
  2. Enter the trainee's full email address, then press Enter. Email is safer than a name.
  3. No match, an expired certificate or an ambiguous name stops without sending.
  4. SENT: email confirms that the English validity notice was sent.

A valid result sends an email immediately

Check the email again before pressing Enter. Do not guess with a partial name.

docs.title: ESR P/CP Training｜照著號碼做
docs.text:
約 95% 自動化 · 發現小 bug 會持續修正 ▶️ 每次都雙擊這個檔案開始 Run ESR Training Automation (中文).cmd 1　打開雙擊上面的 .cmd 檔。 2　輸入號碼點一下黑色視窗，輸入例如 5-1。 3　按 Enter不是點選單。輸入號碼後按鍵盤 Enter。

🔍 點一下任何操作圖片即可放大；用 ＋／－ 縮放，按 Esc 關閉。

先記住：Step 3、7、8、10 會真的寄出 Email

執行前先看清楚姓名與 Email。其他 Step 不會寄信。

docs.title: 每天打開一次：只做這條線
docs.text:
1. 輸入 5-1 → 按 Enter → 會開啟 6 份線上成績活頁簿。
  2. 若要選帳號，選自己的 OAIC／@oaic.io 帳號；保持頁面開啟 1–2 分鐘。
  3. 回到黑色視窗。有白底待處理人員才輸入 5-2；沒有白底人員，今天就完成。

docs.title: 點 Step，直接跳到操作說明
docs.text:
Step 1匯入廠商名單寫入 Register Step 2加入 Site access變更 SharePoint 權限 Step 3寄 Training invitation會立即寄信 Step 4查看白底人員只查看 Step 5-1開線上成績檔同步每天一次 Step 5-2查最新成績5-1 後執行 Step 6產生 PDF 證書建立檔案 Step 7寄 Certificate會立即寄信 Step 8寄重考信會立即寄信 Step 9補同步 Register只有失敗時使用 Step 10查舊證書並通知有效時會寄信 第一次使用：安裝工具 + 顯示 Outlook Bcc
  1. 雙擊 Install ESR Automation Prerequisites.cmd。
  2. 等待顯示 Python packages OK。
  3. Outlook：File → Settings。
  1. Mail → Compose → Always show Bcc。
資料夾在哪裡
  • 工具主資料夾：OAIC Ltd\PROJECT_TWSHXESR - Documents\General\ESR AutoDoc Hub\04_ESR Training
  • 廠商名單：01_Inbox\P_CP Candidate Lists
  • Email templates：00_Template\Training email Templates
  • Training results：02_Processing
  • Certificates：04_Certificates
  • 正式 Register：Safety Document - SFD Register\TWSHXHV_ESR_OverallRegister.xlsm
  • 工具寫入的工作頁：Old Training Register

卡住？

先關閉相關 Excel 與 Outlook 草稿，再回到中文 .cmd 重跑同一個 Step。畫面若出現 FAILED、ERROR 或 WARNING，先截圖，不要直接跳到下一步。

docs.title: Step 1｜匯入廠商 P/CP 候選名單
docs.text:
什麼時候做收到廠商回填的 Excel 名單時。

你要做什麼放檔案 → 輸入 1 → 按 Enter。

會產生什麼人員寫入正式 Register；原始 Excel 移到 Archive。

  1. 尚未取得名單：開啟 00_Template\Training email Templates，寄出 1. Person _ CP Candidate Request.oft。
  2. 收到 Excel：放進 01_Inbox\P_CP Candidate Lists。
  3. 打開中文 .cmd，輸入 1，按 Enter。
  4. 看到 Done. Imported... 代表完成。
  5. 若畫面出現 CONTRACTOR REPLY - Candidate Validity Confirmation：開啟 Template 2，貼上工具已複製的內容，再寄給廠商。

docs.title: Step 2｜加入 SharePoint Site access
docs.text:
什麼時候做Step 1 新增了白底待處理人員。

你要做什麼輸入 2，按 Enter；再選擇 Chrome、Edge 或 Firefox。

會產生什麼候選人取得 ESR Training Hub Site access。

  1. 輸入 2，按 Enter。
  2. 看到選擇瀏覽器：直接按 Enter 使用 Chrome；輸入 E 使用 Edge；輸入 F 使用 Firefox。
  3. 執行時不要碰滑鼠或鍵盤。
  4. 看到 完成 SharePoint Site access：成功 ... 代表完成。

看到沒有白底人員

代表目前不需處理；回到選單即可。

docs.title: Step 3｜寄出 Training invitation
docs.text:
什麼時候做該人員已完成 Step 2。

你要做什麼輸入 3，再輸入一位人員的 Email。

會產生什麼Outlook 立即寄出該人員的 Training invitation。

  1. 先確認要寄給哪一位人員。
  2. 輸入 3，按 Enter。
  3. 輸入畫面要求的單一 Email，再按 Enter。
  4. 看到 SENT: ... training invitation 才代表寄出成功。

這一步會寄信

Email 輸錯時先不要按 Enter。直接關閉黑色視窗，再重新開始。

docs.title: Step 4｜查看白底待處理人員
docs.text:
什麼時候做想先確認目前有哪些人尚未完成時。

你要做什麼輸入 4，按 Enter。

會產生什麼只在黑色視窗列出姓名、等級與 Email；不修改檔案。

看到 目前沒有偵測到白底待處理人員，代表現在沒有要繼續跑 5-2、6、7 的人。

docs.title: Step 5-1｜每天先開線上成績檔同步
docs.text:
什麼時候做每天打開工具時，先做一次。

你要做什麼輸入 5-1 → 選瀏覽器 → 等 1–2 分鐘。

會產生什麼開啟 6 份 Microsoft Forms 線上回覆活頁簿，更新本機成績。

  1. 輸入 5-1，按 Enter。
  2. 直接按 Enter 使用 Chrome；要用 Edge 才輸入 E。
  3. 瀏覽器會開啟 6 個成績頁面。若 Microsoft 詢問帳號，選自己的 OAIC／@oaic.io 帳號。
  4. 不要關頁面，等待 1–2 分鐘。
  5. 回到原本的黑色視窗，再做 Step 5-2。

docs.title: Step 5-2｜查 Training Hub 最新成績
docs.text:
什麼時候做Step 5-1 同步完成，而且 Register 還有白底人員。

你要做什麼輸入 5-2，按 Enter。

會產生什麼每位人員顯示 PASSED 或 WAIT。

  • Person：總分 ≥ 36 才是 PASSED。
  • CP：Module 1 ≥ 20 而且 Module 2 ≥ 20 才是 PASSED。
  • WAIT：先不要做 Step 6 或 7。
  • PASSED：可以繼續 Step 6。

docs.title: Step 6｜產生 PDF 證書
docs.text:
什麼時候做Step 5-2 顯示 PASSED。

你要做什麼輸入 6，按 Enter。

會產生什麼在 04_Certificates 建立 Person／CP PDF 證書。

  1. 輸入 6，按 Enter。
  2. 看到 完成，已自動產生以上 PDF 證書 代表完成。
  3. 打開 04_Certificates，確認姓名、等級與 PDF。

docs.title: Step 7｜寄出 Certificate email
docs.text:
什麼時候做已檢查 Step 6 產生的 PDF。

你要做什麼輸入 7，按 Enter。

會產生什麼寄出所有待寄證書，並嘗試自動同步 Register。

  1. 先關閉不相關的 Outlook 草稿。
  2. 輸入 7，按 Enter。
  3. 若出現「未確認寄出」清單，只在要重寄時輸入編號／Email；一般處理直接按 Enter。
  4. 每人看到 SENT: email，最後看到 Register 同步完成，才算完整完成。

這一步會寄出所有待寄證書

執行前先在 04_Certificates 檢查全部 PDF。不要用 Step 7 測試。

docs.title: Step 8｜寄出 Re-training Required 重考信
docs.text:
什麼時候做Step 5-2 已確認有人未通過，需要重考。

你要做什麼輸入 8，按 Enter。

會產生什麼向所有已確認未通過、尚未通知的人寄出重考信。

  1. 先用 Step 5-2 確認哪些人未通過。
  2. 確認名單正確後才輸入 8，按 Enter。
  3. 系統會列出收件人並直接處理寄送；看到 SENT: re-training required email 才代表成功。

這一步會寄信

如果不確定誰會收到，先不要執行。

docs.title: Step 9｜補同步已寄證書到 Training Register
docs.text:
什麼時候做只有 Step 7 已寄信，但畫面顯示 Register 同步失敗時。

你要做什麼關閉 Register Excel → 輸入 9 → 按 Enter。

會產生什麼把已寄證書狀態、證書號碼與日期補寫回 Register。

正常情況 不用 執行 Step 9。看到 Register 同步完成 就可以離開。

docs.title: Step 10｜查歷史有效證書並寄英文通知
docs.text:
什麼時候做測試者說以前已通過，但 Step 5-2 找不到成績。

你要做什麼輸入 10，再輸入完整 Email。

會產生什麼若找到仍有效證書，立即寄出英文有效通知；無效則不寄。

  1. 輸入 10，按 Enter。
  2. 輸入測試者的完整 Email，再按 Enter。Email 比姓名安全。
  3. 系統找不到、已過期或姓名對到多人時，會停止且不寄信。
  4. 找到仍有效證書時，看到 SENT: email 代表英文通知已寄出。

有效時會立即寄信

輸入前再次確認 Email；不要用不完整姓名猜測。

docs.title: Create Printed PTW PDF｜5 steps
docs.text:
One run performs two checks: new PTW files and existing -CHK.pdf files.

1 🖱️ Check the files, then double-click the .cmd file Process Cancelled PTW - Run.cmd

2 🔎 Wait for Step 1 to check new PTW files

The window shows each file name, progress and Status.

3 ✅ Review the Step 1 result

Cancelled → creates -PRT.pdfOther status → renamed to -CHK.pdf

4 🔁 Step 2 rechecks every -CHK.pdf

Now Cancelled → restores the original name and creates -PRT.pdfNot Cancelled → keeps -CHK.pdf

5 📋 Review the summary, then press any key to close

[DONE] = completed｜[CHECK] = not completedThe window stays open for review.

Processing rules and optional mode
  • Step 1 checks TWSHXHV-PTW-####.pdf files without an exact matching -PRT.pdf.
  • Step 1 Cancelled: keeps the original PDF and creates an image-only -PRT.pdf.
  • Step 1 other status: keeps the content and renames the file to -CHK.pdf.
  • Step 2 rechecks every TWSHXHV-PTW-####-CHK.pdf.
  • A -CHK.pdf that is now Cancelled: restores the original name and creates an image-only -PRT.pdf.
  • A -CHK.pdf that is not Cancelled: keeps its name and appears under [CHECK].
  • Existing files are never overwritten.
  • Temporary PNG files use Windows %TEMP% and are removed when processing finishes.
  • To open files one by one, run the PowerShell script with -OpenEach.

docs.title: 產生圖片化 PTW PDF｜5 步完成
docs.text:
一次執行兩輪檢查：處理新的 PTW，並重新檢查既有的 -CHK.pdf。

1 🖱️ 確認檔案後，雙擊 .cmd Process Cancelled PTW - Run.cmd

[DONE] = 已完成｜[CHECK] = 尚待完成視窗會停留，不會自動消失。

處理規則與選用功能
  • 第一輪：檢查沒有同編號 exact -PRT.pdf 的 TWSHXHV-PTW-####.pdf。
  • 第一輪 Cancelled：保留原始 PDF，另建影像化 -PRT.pdf。
  • 第一輪其他狀態：保留內容，只將檔名改為 -CHK.pdf。
  • 第二輪：重新檢查全部 TWSHXHV-PTW-####-CHK.pdf。

  • -CHK.pdf 尚未 Cancelled：檔名不變，列於 [CHECK]。
  • 不覆寫既有檔案。
  • 中間 PNG 存於 Windows %TEMP%，完成後自動清理。
  • 如需逐份開啟，可執行 PowerShell 程式並加上 -OpenEach。

docs.title: 3DLA MoM Automation - Quick Guide
docs.text:
Hi everyone, to make the daily ESR 3DLA MoM preparation a little easier, this folder now includes an automated Word report generator.

The aim is not to replace anyone's review. It simply takes care of the repetitive parts first, so we can spend more time checking the content, risks, and interfaces properly.

docs.title: Before You Start
docs.text:
• Please complete the target day's 3DLA Overview Excel first.
  • The Overview Excel should be saved in: ..\Overview
  • Please close Word before running the tool, so the Word file is not locked.
  • If the Overview Excel is still open, please save it first.

docs.title: Daily Use
docs.text:
1. Complete and save tomorrow's Overview Excel.
  2. Close all Word windows.
  3. In the MoM folder, double-click: Close Word First - Generate Tomorrow 3DLA MoM.cmd
  4. The tool will generate tomorrow's MoM Word file automatically.
  5. After opening the new Word file, please quickly check:
  6. Date
  7. Meeting no.
  8. 5. Attachments - A. 3DLA Overview
  9. B. HV System Overview
  10. Once checked, continue with any meeting notes or PDF export as usual.

docs.title: What The Automation Does
docs.text:
• Finds the most suitable previous MoM Word file to use as the template.
  • Creates the new Word file using the correct date-based name, for example: OWP2-ESR-3DLA-MOM-260704-01.docx
  • Updates the Word header fields:
  • Date
  • Meeting no.
  • Finds the matching Overview Excel for the target date, for example: OWP2-ESR-3DLA-Overview-20260704.xlsx
  • Captures the 3DLA Overview from the Excel EN worksheet.
  • Uses only the range that contains visible text or values, so empty rows below the table are not pasted into Word.
  • Converts the Overview into an image and inserts it into: 5. Attachments - A. 3DLA Overview
  • Trims unnecessary white space around the image so it fits the page width and stays readable.
  • Keeps the original Word layout, tables, and other attachment content.
  • Does not overwrite an existing file by default, to avoid replacing a version already edited by someone.

docs.title: If The File Already Exists
docs.text:
If a MoM Word file already exists for the same date, the tool will stop and warn you. It will not overwrite it automatically.

If you are sure you want to regenerate it, run this in PowerShell:

powershell -Sta -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "OAIC Ltd\PROJECT_TWSHXESR - Documents\General\3-Day Look Ahead - 3DLA\MoM\Generate Tomorrow 3DLA MoM - Code.ps1" -TargetDate "2026-07-04" -Overwrite -Open

Please change the date to the report date you need.

docs.title: Common Situations
docs.text: Situation What To Do The tool says Word is still open Close all Word windows and run it again The Overview Excel cannot be found Check that the target date Excel exists in ..\Overview Attachment A does not look right Check the Overview Excel content and row heights, then regenerate the MoM The same date MoM already exists Use -Overwrite only if you are sure you want to rebuild it The Word still needs edits That is normal. The tool prepares the draft; final review is still manual

docs.title: Gentle Reminders
docs.text:
• This automation prepares the report draft and inserts the Overview. The final content still needs a human check.
  • If the Overview has many activities, the image will be scaled to fit the page, but it is still worth opening the Word file for a quick look.
  • Saving a few minutes on repeated formatting gives us a little more space to focus on ESR, SIMOPS, and interface checks.

docs.title: 3DLA MoM 自動化 - 快速指南
docs.text:
大家好，為了讓每天產生 ESR 3DLA MoM 稍微輕鬆一點，這個資料夾已經加入自動產生 Word 報告的功能。

它的目的不是取代大家的判斷，而是先把重複、容易漏的小動作做好，讓我們把時間留給真正重要的事：確認內容、風險和介面資訊是否正確。

docs.title: 使用前請先確認
docs.text:
• 今日或明日的 3DLA Overview Excel 已經完成。
  • Overview Excel 放在： ..\Overview
  • Word 請先關閉，避免檔案被鎖住。
  • 如果 Excel 正在編輯 Overview，也建議先儲存。

docs.title: 日常使用方式
docs.text:
1. 先完成並儲存明天的 Overview Excel。
  2. 關閉所有 Word 視窗。
  3. 在 MoM 資料夾雙擊： Close Word First - Generate Tomorrow 3DLA MoM.cmd
  4. 程式會自動產生明天的 MoM Word。
  5. 開啟新 Word 後，請快速檢查：
  6. Date
  7. Meeting no.
  8. 5. Attachments - A. 3DLA Overview
  9. B. HV System Overview
  10. 確認內容後，再手動補充會議內容或輸出 PDF。

docs.title: 這個程式會自動做什麼
docs.text:
• 找到合適的前一份 MoM Word 作為模板。
  • 依日期產生新的檔名，例如： OWP2-ESR-3DLA-MOM-260704-01.docx
  • 自動更新 Word 裡的：
  • Date
  • Meeting no.
  • 從 Overview 資料夾找到目標日期的 Excel，例如： OWP2-ESR-3DLA-Overview-20260704.xlsx
  • 從 Excel EN 工作表擷取 3DLA Overview。
  • 只擷取有文字或數值的範圍，避免把下方空白一起貼進 Word。
  • 將 Overview 轉成圖片並貼到： 5. Attachments - A. 3DLA Overview
  • 自動裁掉圖片周圍多餘空白，讓它看起來貼齊頁寬、比較好讀。
  • 保留原本 Word 的版面、表格和其他附件內容。
  • 預設不覆蓋既有檔案，避免不小心蓋掉同事已修改的版本。

docs.title: 如果當天檔案已經存在
docs.text:
如果已經有同一天的 MoM Word，程式會停止並提醒你，不會直接覆蓋。

如果你確定要重新產生，可以用 PowerShell 執行：

powershell -Sta -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "OAIC Ltd\PROJECT_TWSHXESR - Documents\General\3-Day Look Ahead - 3DLA\MoM\Generate Tomorrow 3DLA MoM - Code.ps1" -TargetDate "2026-07-04" -Overwrite -Open

請把日期改成你要重新產生的日期。

docs.title: 常見狀況
docs.text: 狀況 建議處理 程式說 Word 還開著 關閉所有 Word 視窗後再跑一次 找不到 Overview Excel 先確認 ..\Overview 裡是否已有目標日期 Excel Attachment A 圖片看起來不對 先確認 Overview Excel 的內容和列高是否正常，再重新產生 已經產生過同一天 MoM 若要重做，請用 -Overwrite Word 開啟後內容還要調整 可以正常手動修改，程式只是幫你先做好底稿

docs.title: 小提醒
docs.text:
• 這份自動化主要幫忙做「產生底稿」和「貼 Overview」，最後內容仍需要人工檢查。
  • 如果 Overview Excel 當天工項很多，圖片會自動依頁面空間縮放，但仍建議打開 Word 看一次。
  • 每天多省一點重複操作時間，大家就能多留一點精神給 ESR / SIMOPS / interface 的確認。
